description: This Java source file defines an immutable class SimpleCommand, which models a simple command message with a command name, optional correlation ID, and optional payload. It provides methods to create instances, parse from JSON strings or objects, and serialize to JSON. It also includes nested class JsonFields that defines JSON field constants used for JSON (de)serialization.

classes.name: SimpleCommand
classes.description: Immutable class encapsulating a command with name, optional correlation ID, and optional payload, convertible to/from JSON.

classes.name: SimpleCommand.JsonFields
classes.description: Defines JSON field names used in the serialization/deserialization of SimpleCommand objects.

methods.name: SimpleCommand.of
methods.description: Factory method creating a new SimpleCommand instance with specified command name, correlation ID, and payload.

methods.name: SimpleCommand.fromJson
methods.description: Creates a SimpleCommand instance from a JSON string or JSON object.

methods.name: SimpleCommand.getCorrelationId
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the correlation ID if present.

methods.name: SimpleCommand.getPayload
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the payload if present.

methods.name: SimpleCommand.toJson
methods.description: Serializes the SimpleCommand to a JSON object.
